awardingDay.title: More Than a Certificate: Celebrating Progress at EDUHUB Awarding Day
awardingDay.certificatePhotoAlt: EDUHUB students receiving a certificate at Awarding Day
awardingDay.groupPhotoAlt: EDUHUB students and staff celebrating together at Awarding Day
paragraphs: Every learning journey is made up of small steps. A new word learned, a sentence spoken with more confidence, a difficult lesson finally understood, and the courage to keep showing up are all part of the process. At EDUHUB, we believe that these small moments of progress deserve to be recognized and celebrated. Every three months, EDUHUB holds its Awarding Day, a special occasion dedicated to students who have successfully completed their current learning level and are ready to take the next step in their journey. The event brings together students, teachers, and the EDUHUB community to celebrate their achievements and the progress they have made throughout the learning period.

For our students, receiving a certificate is more than simply marking the completion of a level. Behind every certificate are weeks of attending classes, completing assignments, practicing new skills, overcoming challenges, and gradually becoming more confident in using what they have learned. Moving up to the next level is a reflection of their consistency and commitment to learning. Awarding Day gives students an opportunity to pause and appreciate how far they have come, while also sharing the excitement of reaching a new stage with their classmates and teachers. It is a moment filled with smiles, proud faces, congratulations, and memories that become part of their learning experience at EDUHUB.

At EDUHUB, we believe that education is not only about reaching the final destination, but also about appreciating every step along the way. Each new level brings new challenges, new knowledge, and new opportunities for students to grow both academically and personally. Through Awarding Day, we hope to create a learning community where students feel proud of their achievements and motivated to continue moving forward. The certificates may represent the level they have completed, but the confidence, skills, friendships, and experiences they gain along the way are what make the journey truly meaningful. Every milestone is worth celebrating, and every step forward is another reason to keep learning.

ieltsBritishCouncil.title: EDUHUB and British Council Team Up to Offer IELTS at TISU
ieltsBritishCouncil.registrationRoomPhotoAlt: IELTS registration room at TISU with British Council signage
paragraphs: Termez, Uzbekistan — EDUHUB has announced a new partnership with the British Council in Uzbekistan to host official IELTS testing sessions at Termez University of Economics and Services (TISU), beginning April 2026.

Under the agreement, IELTS test sessions are held twice a month at the TISU main campus, giving students and professionals in the Termez region direct access to one of the world's most widely recognized English language proficiency exams.

The British Council, a UK-based international organization with a longstanding presence in Uzbekistan, administers IELTS globally in accordance with standardized international testing protocols. The organization states its mission as building connections, understanding, and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide.
Candidates can register for upcoming test sessions through the following channels:
The collaboration is part of EDUHUB's broader effort to expand access to internationally recognized qualifications for learners in the Surkhandarya region.
For test dates and further updates, candidates are encouraged to check the British Council website regularly.

bloombergLab.title: Bloomberg Lab at TISU: Preparing Students for a Career in Global Finance
bloombergLab.labPhotoAlt: Students learning in the Bloomberg Lab at TISU
bloombergLab.labClassroomPhotoAlt: Bloomberg Finance Lab at Termiz University of Economics and Service
bloombergLab.labCertificatesPhotoAlt: Students with certificates at the Bloomberg Finance Lab at TISU
paragraphs: In an increasingly competitive global financial industry, students need more than theoretical knowledge to build successful careers. Bloomberg is one of the world's leading providers of financial data, news, and technology, giving professionals and students access to information used to understand financial markets, investment, and economic developments. Through Bloomberg for Education, universities can bring real-world financial data and learning resources into the academic environment, helping students develop practical skills and a stronger understanding of the financial industry.

Recognizing the importance of practical financial education, Termiz University of Economics and Service (TISU) has established a Bloomberg Lab, providing students with an opportunity to explore financial markets and work with Bloomberg tools in an academic setting. The lab supports students in developing practical knowledge in areas such as financial markets, investment analysis, and economic data. Through Bloomberg's educational and certification programs, students can further strengthen their knowledge and gain credentials that complement their academic background. These opportunities allow students to connect what they learn in the classroom with the tools, data, and practices used in the professional financial industry.

As part of its commitment to expanding international learning opportunities, TISU has also collaborated with EMU University Tashkent, creating opportunities for students to gain practical exposure beyond their regular classroom experience. Through this collaboration, EMU students had the opportunity to participate in Bloomberg-related learning activities at TISU and develop their understanding of financial markets using Bloomberg resources. The initiative reflects a shared commitment to preparing students for the global job market by combining academic education with practical, industry-relevant experience. By gaining exposure to internationally recognized financial tools and learning opportunities, students are better equipped to pursue future careers in finance, business, economics, and other related fields.
